name: Mark
source:
Bright's former betrothed. 
He became a knight of Feline thanks to Bright who asked Orchid to write a recommendation letter for him. 
After some unfortunate events happened to Bright, fearing for his own reputation, he broke off their engagement and chose another fiancee.
